issue.title: fix: shell bg command fails when not first command in code block

steps:
Run this shell block exactly as written:

cd /tmp
bg sleep 30
expected: The `bg` command starts a background job (`Started background job #1: ...`) even when it follows other commands, or a clear error explains the limitation.
defect: When `bg` is not the first command in the block it falls through to bash's builtin and fails with `bash: line 32: bg: no job control`.
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/994 (commit f32186a63ec3b9a763f2348dfdae535844dfcbab). In v0.31.0, execute_shell recognised the background-job syntax only via `cmd.strip().lower().startswith("bg ")`, i.e. when `bg` was the first token of the whole block. With a preceding `cd` line (or `cd ... && bg ...`) the block was sent unchanged to the persistent non-interactive bash, where `bg` is the job-control builtin and fails with 'no job control'. PR #994 scans each line for a leading `bg `, runs the preceding lines in the stateful shell first and then starts the background job. The fix ships in v0.32.0. Note that the `&&` variant is not handled by #994, and at the pinned revision the `bg <cmd>` prefix syntax has been removed altogether (background jobs are requested with a `background` argument), so a literal `bg` there always reaches the bash builtin by design.

_meta.notes: The pinned revision 0c131bb0d642fcdd1edb2c6fec02eccfe7f71a07 (v0.35.1) already contains the fix, but no release that lacks the fix provides the gptme-acp entry point (gptme-acp first appears in pyproject.toml at commit 75d94dd34, 2025-12-18, first tagged in v0.31.1.dev20260227 / v0.32.0), so version_choice stays 'pinned'. Because the faulty code no longer exists at the tested revision, 'fault location' is left empty and the pre-fix location is recorded here instead: gptme/tools/shell.py execute_shell (`if cmd_lower.startswith("bg ")`) at f32186a63^. A commit containing ACP but not the fix exists (e.g. 75d94dd34..f32186a63^, Dec 18-25 2025) but no tag. Important: at the pinned revision execute_shell has no `bg ` prefix handling at all (background is a kwarg; see execute_shell at line 3615), so running these steps at the pinned revision will show `bg: no job control` for a different reason (feature removed/renamed), not this bug. Steps replace `npm run dev` with `sleep 30` (round-4 plan).
